g.text: eNav explores glanceable navigation in a wrist-worn form. The
prototype connects an ESP32 board, display and phone-fed data
The electronics were tested through Arduino IDE and the serial
monitor. A custom solder-board PCB compressed the wiring into a
plug-and-play layout for the ESP board.
The project compared Raspberry Pi and Espressif boards before
selecting the ESP32. Interface tests used mock serial data; a live
navigation interface would require a maps API.
